pillars.name: Social
pillars.story: Development achievements, youth inclusion, health and ageing

cards.name: Human Development Index
cards.subtitle: Very high human development, reflecting health, education and income achievements.

cards.name: Youth outside Employment, Education or Training
cards.subtitle: Youth inclusion remains important even when overall employment conditions are stronger.

cards.name: Prevalence of Overweight and Obesity
cards.subtitle: Excess weight highlights the importance of prevention and long-term health care; this is not obesity alone.

cards.name: Older Population
cards.subtitle: An older population increases the importance of accessible services, care and social protection.
cards.scope: PAHO describes people over 65; retain this wording pending detailed age metadata.

pillars.name: Economic
pillars.story: Public financing, goods trade exposure and tourism earnings

cards.name: Total Public Debt
cards.subtitle: Public debt and outstanding arrears constrain room for development and resilience investment.

cards.name: Merchandise Trade Balance
cards.subtitle: Goods imports exceed goods exports; services, including tourism, are excluded.

cards.name: Gross Tourism Receipts
cards.subtitle: Tourism generates substantial external earnings. This ratio is not tourism’s contribution to GDP.

pillars.name: Environmental
pillars.story: Disaster exposure, energy dependence and marine biodiversity protection

cards.name: Barbuda Homes Damaged by Hurricane Irma
cards.subtitle: Damage across Barbuda shows why resilient housing and disaster preparedness matter.
cards.scope: Barbuda only; historical damage, not current housing condition.

cards.name: Electricity Generation Mix
cards.subtitle: Non-renewable generation dominates electricity supply, linking energy transition with resilience.

cards.name: Protected Coverage of Marine Biodiversity Sites
cards.subtitle: Average protected-area coverage within marine KBAs; not the share of national waters protected.
cards.source: UN Statistics Division, SDG country profile
cards.scope: Average proportion of marine KBAs covered by protected areas.

notes: Water and food security are narrative priorities; no unverified current dependence percentage is displayed.
Each card preserves its reference year and estimate or historical-event status.
